# Ignix UI - React Component Library

## Project Description
Ignix UI is a CLI-based React component library built on the copy-paste ownership model (similar to shadcn/ui). Components are installed directly into a user's project, giving full control to customize and modify them.

Ignix UI is designed to be deterministic and AI-friendly.

## Framework & Styling
- Framework: React 18+
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Language: TypeScript
- Installation Model: Copy-paste ownership

## CLI Usage

Initialize Ignix in a project:

npx ignix init

Add a component interactively:

npx ignix

Add a component directly:

npx ignix add component <component-name>

Zero-interaction mode (for AI agents):

npx ignix add component <component-name> --yes

Example:

npx ignix add component button --yes

## Deterministic Output

When --yes is provided, the CLI produces predictable logs:

Installing button
Created src/components/ui/button/index.tsx
Installed button

No interactive prompts are shown in this mode.

## Component Registry

Machine-readable registry location:

packages/registry/registry.json

This file contains all available components, templates, dependencies, and file paths.
